product.one_liner: Literfy is an AI academic research tool that helps students and researchers find papers, organize sources, and start literature reviews faster.

core_features.description: Search and discover academic papers based on a research topic.
core_features.user_benefit: Helps users find relevant papers faster instead of opening many random tabs.
core_features.visual_need: Screen recording of typing a research topic and getting paper results.

core_features.description: Help users discover relevant or related papers for a research topic.
core_features.user_benefit: Helps users avoid missing useful papers during early research.
core_features.visual_need: Screen recording of paper result list, related papers, or ranked results.

core_features.description: Generate a structured outline for a literature review based on selected papers.
core_features.user_benefit: Helps users stop staring at a blank page and start with a clear structure.
core_features.visual_need: Screen recording of selected papers turning into an outline.

core_features.description: Generate a structured literature review draft based on collected papers.
core_features.user_benefit: Helps users move from paper collection to a draftable structure faster.
core_features.visual_need: Screen recording of a review draft or editable review sections.

core_features.description: Export citations or research materials into downstream writing workflows.
core_features.user_benefit: Helps users organize and move research materials into writing tools.
core_features.visual_need: Screen recording of export options, citation export, or document export.

most_painful_user_scenarios: A student starts a literature review and opens 30-50 random tabs.
A PhD or Master student does not know which papers are worth reading first.
A researcher has papers but does not know how to organize them into a review structure.
A student wastes hours before actually writing anything.
forbidden_claims: Do not say Literfy writes a perfect literature review.
Do not say Literfy replaces real research.
Do not say citations are always 100% correct.
Do not tell users to submit AI output directly.
Do not claim guaranteed acceptance by journals or professors.
Do not claim the output is publication-ready without human review.
good_tiktok_angles: If your literature review starts with 50 random tabs open, this is for you.
This is how I start a literature review now.
I stopped staring at a blank page before writing my literature review.
Stop searching papers manually like this.
product.source_grounding_note: Literfy generates literature review outlines and drafts based on real academic papers selected or discovered in the workflow.
allowed_claim_boundaries: Can say Literfy works from real academic papers in the workflow.
Can say Literfy helps generate a structured literature review draft based on selected/collected papers.
Can say Literfy helps users move from real papers to an organized review starting point.
Should still say users need to review, edit, and verify the output.
